clean.about: A modern product: a calm, credible layout that lets the content lead.
clean.brief: Hero: `split` with a short headline, a `lead` and two buttons beside a `frame-browser` or `frame-phone` showing the product's main screen built from real kit parts. Below it, a `logo-row` or three `stat`s, then features as a `grid-3` of `card`s with `icon-badge`s, a `steps` row for how it works, one `quote`, and a closing call to action in `section-soft`. Neutral surfaces with the primary colour only on actions and small highlights; consistent card heights; generous gaps. Avoid: more than one coloured section per screen, centred text in long paragraphs.

soft.about: Warm and friendly: rounded, approachable, for local services, families, wellness and community.
soft.brief: Hero: `split` with the headline and a pill button beside a `media media-mesh media-arch` (or `media-round`) art panel with a `float-card` overlapping it (a rating, the next opening, a price). Sections alternate `section` and `section-soft`; features sit in borderless `card`s with `icon-badge`s; quotes have `avatar`s. Big radii, tinted surfaces, `chip`s for choices, cheerful but specific copy. Avoid: hard lines and dense tables; dark sections.

editorial.about: Magazine-like: serif headlines, long measure, white space, for writers, studios, restaurants and portfolios.
editorial.brief: Hero: a left-aligned `display` headline over a `lead`, with a `kicker` above and a `rule` below, then a `media-wide` art panel (`media-lines` or `media-mesh`) spanning the container. Content runs in `grid-2` columns with numbered `kicker`s (01, 02…), `menu-item` lists with leaders for menus or price lists, and one large `quote`. Thin rules between sections, small uppercase labels, restrained colour (ink and one accent). Avoid: icon badges in grids, shadows, pill buttons.

bold.about: Confident and high-contrast: oversized type and colour blocks, for launches, fitness, events and creative brands.
bold.brief: Hero: a `section section-dark` band (the whole first screen dark) with a left-aligned `display` headline of three to six words, one word in `text-accent`, a `lead`, a big `btn-lg` and a `btn-secondary`; below the headline, a row of three `stat`s or a `bento` of class or feature tiles. Then a `section section-primary` band with a short statement or huge `stat`s, a `bento` of features (one `tall`, one `span-4`), a timetable or list in plain `table` or `list` form, and a `section-dark` closing call to action. Choose a palette whose primary colour is itself vivid (red, orange, electric blue, magenta), never one whose primary is a grey or brown with the colour only in the accent (such as charcoal-ember, graphite-lime, storm-grey, onyx-pearl). Tight tracking, heavy weights, strong contrast between sections, short punchy copy. Avoid: large gradient art panels, many small cards, muted pastel combinations, long paragraphs.

minimal.about: Quiet and airy: hairlines, space and restraint, for premium products, architecture, consultancies and luxury.
minimal.brief: Hero: a centred `display` (or `h1`) with a one-line `lead` and a single `btn-secondary`, lots of space, then a `media-wide` art panel (`media-dots` or `media-lines`). Content is `grid-3` without cards, separated by `rule`s, `kicker` numbers and short lines of text; one `quote` without an avatar. Monochrome first; the primary colour appears once or twice per screen; hairline borders. Avoid: icon badges, gradients, shadows, more than one button per section.

studio.about: A sharp tech product or startup: gradients, glass and a product shot, the look of a modern software launch.
studio.brief: Hero: centred `glow` with a `badge` above a `display` headline (key words in `text-gradient`), a `lead`, two buttons, then a `frame-browser` holding a believable product screen (a `topbar`, a `table` or `stat`s, a chart drawn with `media-dots`). Follow with a `logo-row`, a `bento` of `glass` tiles with icons and one-line benefits, `steps`, pricing `card`s with the middle one highlighted, and a `section-dark` call to action. Dark palettes suit it well; tight headings, small precise labels, product UI as the hero image. Avoid: warm handmade touches, serif type, photo placeholders where a product screen would do.

craft.about: Handmade and local: warm serif headings and menu-board details, for bakeries, cafes, makers, farms and small shops.
craft.brief: Hero: `split` with an `eyebrow` (the neighbourhood or since-year), a serif headline and a `lead`, beside a `media media-arch` art panel with a `float-card` (today's special, opening hours). Use `menu-item` rows with leaders for products and prices, `chip`s for categories, a `table` of opening hours, quotes from regulars, and a visit-us section with the address. Cream and earthy palettes, small-caps labels, stamp-like `badge`s, friendly specific copy (names, days, prices). Avoid: tech product frames, gradients, bento grids.
